A filha do radialista Luciano Sassinhora, Camile Vitória Araújo de Souza, que morreu aos 23 anos após lutar contra a leucemia, descobriu o câncer depois de sentir uma "fraqueza absurda". Nas redes sociais, a jovem relatou como chegou ao diagnóstico em maio deste ano. A morte de Camile foi anunciada pelos familiares.
" O que eu quero dizer com essa fraqueza? Não era tipo "tô cansada do dia de trabalho". Era uma fraqueza de que eu levantava o braço, ai, meu Deus. Eu não ficava em pé, eu tinha que sentar. Eu tava tomando banho sentada", descreveu em um vídeo postado quando ela recebeu o diagnóstico (veja acima). 
Ela faleceu na sexta-feira (25), em Goiânia, após alguns meses em tratamento contra a leucemia linfoide aguda (LLA-B). Ao sentir os primeiros sintomas, Camile relatou que achava que se tratava de uma anemia. Ela contou que primeiro sentiu uma dor na garganta que queimava muito, tratada com antibiótico. Depois surgiram hematomas pelo corpo, mas os que chamaram a atenção da jovem foram os que apareceram entre os dedos.

LEIA TAMBÉM:
"Como sou muito branca, já estou bem acostumada com roxos na perna. Só que uma coisa que eu achei muito estranha: começaram a surgir roxos entre os meus dedos, coisa que nunca aconteceu", relatou. Camile contou que continuou com as atividades cotidianas mesmo com o cansaço e a fraqueza, até que o psiquiatra dela pediu exames de sangue de rotina.
"O próprio laboratório ligou para a minha mãe e falou que meus exames deram muito alterados e que era pra ocorrer pra emergência. Na hora que eu vi o resultado dos exames, o meu mundo caiu", relatou. Camile foi para emergência, onde fez novos exames que também indicaram alterações.
Após vários exames para chegarem a um diagnóstico preciso, Camile foi submetida a uma biópsia de medula óssea que revelou a leucemia linfoide aguda. "Eu fiquei, de certa forma, aliviada, por que aliviada? Porque eu tinha uma resposta para o que estava acontecendo e agora, finalmente, a gente poderia tratar da forma correta", contou.

Em nota, a rádio em que Luciano Sassinhora atua prestou homenagem a Camile. "Não existem palavras capazes de aliviar uma perda tão dolorosa", declarou. A jovem foi velada no Cemitério Parque Memorial de Goiânia.
Neste sábado, o pai Luciano, o irmão Luciano Jacob e o namorado João Antônio postaram um vídeo que mostra momento do sepultamento de Camile, quando soltando balões rosa (veja abaixo).

deduped_items.title: Filha de radialista que morreu aos 23 anos descobriu câncer após sentir ‘fraqueza absurda’
deduped_items.summary: Filha de radialista morre aos 23 anos com leucemia A filha do radialista Luciano Sassinhora, Camile Vitória Araújo de Souza, que morreu aos 23 anos após lutar contra a leucemia, descobriu o câncer depois de sentir uma "fraqueza absurda". Nas redes sociais, a jovem relatou como chegou ao diagnóstico em maio deste ano. A morte de Camile foi anunciada pelos familiares. " O que eu quero dizer com essa fraqueza? Não era tipo "tô cansada do dia de trabalho". Era uma fraqueza de que eu levantava o braç
deduped_items.body_text:
A filha do radialista Luciano Sassinhora, Camile Vitória Araújo de Souza, que morreu aos 23 anos após lutar contra a leucemia, descobriu o câncer depois de sentir uma "fraqueza absurda". Nas redes sociais, a jovem relatou como chegou ao diagnóstico em maio deste ano. A morte de Camile foi anunciada pelos familiares.
" O que eu quero dizer com essa fraqueza? Não era tipo "tô cansada do dia de trabalho". Era uma fraqueza de que eu levantava o braço, ai, meu Deus. Eu não ficava em pé, eu tinha que sentar. Eu tava tomando banho sentada", descreveu em um vídeo postado quando ela recebeu o diagnóstico (veja acima). 
Ela faleceu na sexta-feira (25), em Goiânia, após alguns meses em tratamento contra a leucemia linfoide aguda (LLA-B). Ao sentir os primeiros sintomas, Camile relatou que achava que se tratava de uma anemia. Ela contou que primeiro sentiu uma dor na garganta que queimava muito, tratada com antibiótico. Depois surgiram hematomas pelo corpo, mas os que chamaram a atenção da jovem foram os que apareceram entre os dedos.
Filha de radialista morre aos 23 anos com leucemia em Goiás — Foto: Reprodução/Instagram Camile Vitória
LEIA TAMBÉM:
"Como sou muito branca, já estou bem acostumada com roxos na perna. Só que uma coisa que eu achei muito estranha: começaram a surgir roxos entre os meus dedos, coisa que nunca aconteceu", relatou. Camile contou que continuou com as atividades cotidianas mesmo com o cansaço e a fraqueza, até que o psiquiatra dela pediu exames de sangue de rotina.
"O próprio laboratório ligou para a minha mãe e falou que meus exames deram muito alterados e que era pra ocorrer pra emergência. Na hora que eu vi o resultado dos exames, o meu mundo caiu", relatou. Camile foi para emergência, onde fez novos exames que também indicaram alterações.
Após vários exames para chegarem a um diagnóstico preciso, Camile foi submetida a uma biópsia de medula óssea que revelou a leucemia linfoide aguda. "Eu fiquei, de certa forma, aliviada, por que aliviada? Porque eu tinha uma resposta para o que estava acontecendo e agora, finalmente, a gente poderia tratar da forma correta", contou.
Filha de radialista morre aos 23 anos com leucemia em Goiás — Foto: Reprodução/Instagram de Camile Vitória
Comoção e homenagens
Os amigos e familiares de Camile prestaram homenagens nas redes sociais. Uma das familiares a homenagear Amanda Borges. Ela ressaltou que a jovem era radiante.
"Eu não queria ter que me despedir de você... A menina mais linda que meus olhos já viram. A pureza da sua alma realmente não era para esse mundo... Prometo me lembrar de você bem, feliz, radiante!", declarou. 
Em nota, a rádio em que Luciano Sassinhora atua prestou homenagem a Camile. "Não existem palavras capazes de aliviar uma perda tão dolorosa", declarou. A jovem foi velada no Cemitério Parque Memorial de Goiânia.
Neste sábado, o pai Luciano, o irmão Luciano Jacob e o namorado João Antônio postaram um vídeo que mostra momento do sepultamento de Camile, quando soltando balões rosa (veja abaixo).

" O que eu quero dizer com essa fraqueza? Não era tipo "tô cansada do dia de trabalho". Era uma fraqueza de que eu levantava o braço, ai, meu Deus. Eu não ficava em pé, eu tinha que sentar. Eu tava tomando banho sentada", descreveu em um vídeo postado quando ela recebeu o diagnóstico (veja acima). 
Ela faleceu na sexta-feira (25), em Goiânia, após alguns meses em tratamento contra a leucemia linfoide aguda (LLA-B). Ao sentir os primeiros sintomas, Camile relatou que achava que se tratava de uma anemia. Ela contou que primeiro sentiu uma dor na garganta que queimava muito, tratada com antibiótico. Depois surgiram hematomas pelo corpo, mas os que chamaram a atenção da jovem foram os que apareceram entre os dedos.
Filha de radialista morre aos 23 anos com leucemia em Goiás — Foto: Reprodução/Instagram Camile Vitória
LEIA TAMBÉM:
"Como sou muito branca, já estou bem acostumada com roxos na perna. Só que uma coisa que eu achei muito estranha: começaram a surgir roxos entre os meus dedos, coisa que nunca aconteceu", relatou. Camile contou que continuou com as atividades cotidianas mesmo com o cansaço e a fraqueza, até que o psiquiatra dela pediu exames de sangue de rotina.
"O próprio laboratório ligou para a minha mãe e falou que meus exames deram muito alterados e que era pra ocorrer pra emergência. Na hora que eu vi o resultado dos exames, o meu mundo caiu", relatou. Camile foi para emergência, onde fez novos exames que também indicaram alterações.
Após vários exames para chegarem a um diagnóstico preciso, Camile foi submetida a uma biópsia de medula óssea que revelou a leucemia linfoide aguda. "Eu fiquei, de certa forma, aliviada, por que aliviada? Porque eu tinha uma resposta para o que estava acontecendo e agora, finalmente, a gente poderia tratar da forma correta", contou.
Filha de radialista morre aos 23 anos com leucemia em Goiás — Foto: Reprodução/Instagram de Camile Vitória
Comoção e homenagens
Os amigos e familiares de Camile prestaram homenagens nas redes sociais. Uma das familiares a homenagear Amanda Borges. Ela ressaltou que a jovem era radiante.
"Eu não queria ter que me despedir de você... A menina mais linda que meus olhos já viram. A pureza da sua alma realmente não era para esse mundo... Prometo me lembrar de você bem, feliz, radiante!", declarou. 
Em nota, a rádio em que Luciano Sassinhora atua prestou homenagem a Camile. "Não existem palavras capazes de aliviar uma perda tão dolorosa", declarou. A jovem foi velada no Cemitério Parque Memorial de Goiânia.
Neste sábado, o pai Luciano, o irmão Luciano Jacob e o namorado João Antônio postaram um vídeo que mostra momento do sepultamento de Camile, quando soltando balões rosa (veja abaixo).

deduped_items.title: Info ministry rejects Afghan Taliban's 'frivolous' claims linking Pakistan to reported Nuristan violence
deduped_items.summary: The information ministry on Sunday rejected Afghanistan’s claims of Pakistani forces’ alleged involvement in any “internal clashes” in the neighbouring country’s Nuristan province. “The allegations by the Afghan Taliban regime linking Pakistan with the alleged violence in Nuristan are frivolous, baseless and devoid of any truth,” the information ministry’s “fact-check” account on X said. It added: “Pakistan categorically rejects the fabricated claims of involvement by its security forces or inte
deduped_items.body_text:
The information ministry on Sunday rejected Afghanistan’s claims of Pakistani forces’ alleged involvement in any “internal clashes” in the neighbouring country’s Nuristan province.
“The allegations by the Afghan Taliban regime linking Pakistan with the alleged violence in Nuristan are frivolous, baseless and devoid of any truth,” the information ministry’s “fact-check” account on X said.
It added: “Pakistan categorically rejects the fabricated claims of involvement by its security forces or intelligence agencies in any internal clashes in Nuristan or elsewhere in Afghanistan, including allegations of recruiting or training former Afghan security personnel or facilitating Daesh or any other terrorist group operating in Afghanistan.”
The information ministry’s statement came after Afghanistan’s defence ministry alleged that Pakistan-backed individuals had crossed the border and were involved in the reported violence.
The information ministry pointed out that “not a shred of evidence has been produced to substantiate Pakistan’s involvement; no identities, documents, communications, forensic evidence or independent verification”.
It further noted that an alleged video “being peddled on social media to support this false claim only shows a few unarmed individuals who are not even properly dressed or equipped were arrested in what seems to be a pre-planned video shoot by Afghan Taliban regime, well known for lies and fabricated claims”.
“Instead of externalising responsibility for its internal security challenges through fanciful allegations, the Afghan Taliban regime should take credible and verifiable action against terrorist organisations operating from its territory and fulfil its commitments that Afghan soil will not be used for terrorism against Pakistan or any other country.”
The statement further said it was “particularly ironic for the Afghan Taliban regime to accuse Pakistan of supporting terrorism while terrorist organisations operating from Afghanistan continue to pose a direct threat to Pakistan and regional security”.
The ministry highlighted that the presence and activities of “terrorist groups of all types inside Afghanistan are well documented”, including in successive reports of the United Nations and other neutral international organisations.
“Attempts to manufacture a Pakistani connection cannot obscure the reality that these terrorist groups continue to find sanctuary and [a] permissive environment for growth in Afghan territory,” it asserted.
“Such claims by this non-inclusive, non-representative Taliban regime are also reflective of lies to externalise internal dissent and oppression of women, children and minorities,” the ministry said.
Islamabad has repeatedly urged the Taliban administration in Kabul to dismantle terrorist sanctuaries on Afghan soil, particularly those linked to the banned Tehreek-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), that are used for attacks in Pakistan. Officials say those appeals have gone unheeded.
According to a UN Security Council-mandated monitoring report — covering the period from Dec 16, 2025 to June 9, 2026 — Afghan Taliban’s continued support for TTP has contributed to a rise in the frequency and lethality of terrorist attacks in Pakistan, even as Kabul has taken some initial steps to rein in the group.
The report also pointed to growing operational and facilitation linkages among the TTP, Al Qaeda, Islamic State-Khorasan (ISIL-K) and the Baloch Liberation Army (BLA).
Pak-Afghan tensions
Ties between the two neighbours have been strained in the past few years as Islamabad continues to voice its concern over cross-border terrorism. Meanwhile, September witnessed another bout of conflict between Pakistan and Afghanistan.
On Sept 21, in response to recent major terrorist attacks in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan conducted “calibrated” airstrikes in the border region with Afghanistan against terrorist hideouts, with the government saying more than 28 terrorists were killed.
Information Minister

deduped_items.title: Newly inducted Hangor-class submarine conducts maiden live weapon firing in Arabian Sea: ISPR
deduped_items.summary: The navy’s first Hangor-class submarine successfully conducted its maiden live weapon firing in the Arabian Sea, Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR) said on Sunday. The Hangor-class submarine arrived at Karachi Port in June, underscoring the deepening strategic defence cooperation between Pakistan and China. Terming it a “major demonstration of operational readiness”, ISPR said the newly inducted PNS/M HANGOR accurately engaged a “designated long-range target with an anti-ship cruise missile”
deduped_items.body_text:
The navy’s first Hangor-class submarine successfully conducted its maiden live weapon firing in the Arabian Sea, Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR) said on Sunday.
The Hangor-class submarine arrived at Karachi Port in June, underscoring the deepening strategic defence cooperation between Pakistan and China.
Terming it a “major demonstration of operational readiness”, ISPR said the newly inducted PNS/M HANGOR accurately engaged a “designated long-range target with an anti-ship cruise missile” during the weapon firing exercise.
Chief of the Naval Staff Admiral Naveed Ashraf witnessed the firing, praising the submarine’s combat power and emphasising the “strategic importance of enhancing subsurface capabilities for credible maritime deterrence”.
“The milestone underscores the Pakistan Navy’s commitment to maintaining a modern, combat-ready force to safeguard national maritime frontiers and regional peace,” ISPR highlighted.
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif congratulated the Pakistan Navy and its leadership on the first live weapons firing by the newly inducted submarine, according to a statement issued by his office.
“The submarine successfully struck a long-range target with an anti-ship cruise missile, demonstrating the operational readiness, professional expertise and combat capability of Pakistan Navy’s submarine force,” the premier was quoted as saying.
PM Shehbaz reaffirmed the government’s commitment to ensuring the armed forces’ readiness to tackle national security challenges, the statement added. He also commended the Naval chief and the personnel involved in the induction and operationalisation of the submarine.
President Asif Ali Zardari paid tribute to the navy on the successful firing, lauding the “operational readiness and enhancement” of naval defence capabilities, his office said in a post on X.
“Equipped with modern combat capabilities, the Pakistan Navy is playing a vital role in safeguarding national maritime boundaries and ensuring regional peace and security,” President Zardari was quoted as saying.
The statement added that President Zardari was a chief guest at the handover ceremony of the Hangor-class submarine on April 30.
The navy is set to induct a total of eight Hangor-class submarines.
The Hangor-class submarine is equipped with advanced combat systems, modern sensors, Air Independent Propulsion (AIP) technology and enhanced stealth features, which will significantly enhance the navy’s combat capability.
The name Hangor holds a significant place in Pakistan’s naval history, referring to the 1971 Pakistan-India war, during which then-PNS Hangor became the first submarine since World War II to sink a warship when it sank the Indian frigate INS Khukri.
The first of the new submarines was launched in China in April 2024, while the second, third and fourth were launched on March 15, Aug 15 and Dec 17 in 2025, respectively.
On April 21, the Pakistan Navy conducted a successful test of an indigenously developed Anti-Ship Weapon System — Taimoor, the military’s media wing said.
In the same month, the Pakistan Navy fired a locally developed anti-ship ballistic missile to engage targets at an extended range.
“In a resolute display of preparedness and precision-strike capability, Pakistan Navy successfully conducted a live weapon firing of an indigenously developed ship-launched anti-ship missile, accurately engaging its target with high speed at extended range,” the ISPR had said at the time.

deduped_items.title: Two giant pandas sent by China arrive in US
deduped_items.body_text:
Two giant pandas sent by China arrive in US
- By AFP -
- Sep 27, 2026
Two giant pandas sent by China arrived in the United States on Sunday, Beijing’s state media said, after a leaders’ summit that was heavy on symbolism and light on major breakthroughs.
The pandas’ transfer had already been agreed but the departure was announced Thursday during Chinese President Xi Jinping’s visit to Washington.
The black-and-white mammals are immensely popular around the world, and China loans them out as part of a “panda diplomacy” programme to foster foreign ties.
Ping Ping and Fu Shuang departed from Chengdu Shuangliu International Airport on a chartered flight at around 3:00 am (1900 GMT on Saturday), state news agency Xinhua reported.
After a 16-hour flight that crossed the international date line, the bears touched down in Atlanta, Georgia shortly before 7:00 am local time (1100 GMT on Sunday), Xinhua said later.
Steamed corn buns, bamboo shoots and carrots were prepared to keep the pandas nourished during their flight, Chinese state-run media the Global Times reported.
The Boeing 777 operated by FedEx was the top-tracked aircraft on aviation information platform FlightRadar24 as it neared Alaska, roughly halfway into its journey.
The pandas will be hosted by Zoo Atlanta for the next 10 years.
A farewell ceremony was held for the pair before their departure by the Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding.
Experienced keepers were dispatched by the US side to accompany the duo on their flight, the Global Times reported.
In preparation for their arrival, Zoo Atlanta has renovated its panda facilities and assembled a team of animal caretakers.
It has also ensured a stable and long-term supply of bamboo, grown locally in Atlanta, which has a climate that is very similar to Chengdu.
Zoo Atlanta previously hosted pandas on loan from China for a quarter of a century starting in 1999, but it has not had any since 2024.
Both arrivals were born in 2020. Ping Ping, a male, is now six years old while Fu Shuang, a female, will turn six next month.
Pandas in captivity typically live for around 30 years.
Beijing has sent the furry creatures across the globe for decades as soft-power ambassadors of its diplomatic goodwill.
In 1972, China gifted a pair of pandas to Washington, following US president Richard Nixon’s historic visit to the Communist nation.
Beijing recalled two of its pandas from Japan early this year, following a diplomatic spat that began when Japan’s prime minister hinted that Tokyo could intervene militarily in the event of any attack on Taiwan.

deduped_items.title: Egyptian talent key to attracting global companies to Egypt
deduped_items.summary: Ahmed al-Zaher, CEO of the Information Technology Industry Development Agency (ITIDA), said Egyptian talent is the key factor driving global technology companies to choose Egypt for expansion and international service centers. Speaking at the ninth edition of DevOpsDays Cairo 2026, El Zaher said rapid advances in artificial intelligence, particularly Agentic AI, are reshaping software development … The post Egyptian talent key to attracting global companies to Egypt appeared first on Egypt Indep
deduped_items.body_text:
Ahmed al-Zaher, CEO of the Information Technology Industry Development Agency (ITIDA), said Egyptian talent is the key factor driving global technology companies to choose Egypt for expansion and international service centers.
Speaking at the ninth edition of DevOpsDays Cairo 2026, El Zaher said rapid advances in artificial intelligence, particularly Agentic AI, are reshaping software development and operations, requiring updated work methodologies, governance and security frameworks, and continued investment in specialized skills.
He highlighted ITIDA’s role, through its Software Engineering Competence Center (SECC), in developing Egyptian capabilities through specialized training, consulting, technical capacity building, and international certifications, enhancing the competitiveness of Egyptian engineers and companies in global markets.
El Zaher said global companies have repeatedly highlighted the quality of Egyptian talent in their meetings with ITIDA, citing a recent meeting with NVIDIA, which expressed appreciation for Egyptian developers and startup founders. NVIDIA’s programs include more than 200 Egyptian startups and around 46,000 programmers, he said.
He added that continued expansion by global companies in Egypt to serve international markets reflects growing confidence in Egyptian talent and strengthens the country’s position as a global technology and digital-services hub.
Held under the theme “Sustainable DevOps in the Agentic AI Era,” the conference brought together local and international experts to discuss AI, cloud computing, cybersecurity and the future of software development and operations. The ninth edition featured 66 speakers, including 13 international speakers from nine countries.
ITIDA has hosted DevOpsDays Cairo since 2018, making Cairo the only Arab city to host the conference, which is held in more than 60 cities worldwide.

deduped_items.title: Egyptian talent key to attracting global companies to Egypt
deduped_items.summary: Ahmed al-Zaher, CEO of the Information Technology Industry Development Agency (ITIDA), said Egyptian talent is the key factor driving global technology companies to choose Egypt for expansion and international service centers. Speaking at the ninth edition of DevOpsDays Cairo 2026, El Zaher said rapid advances in artificial intelligence, particularly Agentic AI, are reshaping software development … The post Egyptian talent key to attracting global companies to Egypt appeared first on Egypt Indep
deduped_items.body_text:
Ahmed al-Zaher, CEO of the Information Technology Industry Development Agency (ITIDA), said Egyptian talent is the key factor driving global technology companies to choose Egypt for expansion and international service centers.
Speaking at the ninth edition of DevOpsDays Cairo 2026, El Zaher said rapid advances in artificial intelligence, particularly Agentic AI, are reshaping software development and operations, requiring updated work methodologies, governance and security frameworks, and continued investment in specialized skills.
He highlighted ITIDA’s role, through its Software Engineering Competence Center (SECC), in developing Egyptian capabilities through specialized training, consulting, technical capacity building, and international certifications, enhancing the competitiveness of Egyptian engineers and companies in global markets.
El Zaher said global companies have repeatedly highlighted the quality of Egyptian talent in their meetings with ITIDA, citing a recent meeting with NVIDIA, which expressed appreciation for Egyptian developers and startup founders. NVIDIA’s programs include more than 200 Egyptian startups and around 46,000 programmers, he said.
He added that continued expansion by global companies in Egypt to serve international markets reflects growing confidence in Egyptian talent and strengthens the country’s position as a global technology and digital-services hub.
Held under the theme “Sustainable DevOps in the Agentic AI Era,” the conference brought together local and international experts to discuss AI, cloud computing, cybersecurity and the future of software development and operations. The ninth edition featured 66 speakers, including 13 international speakers from nine countries.
ITIDA has hosted DevOpsDays Cairo since 2018, making Cairo the only Arab city to host the conference, which is held in more than 60 cities worldwide.

deduped_items.body_text:
Rizeigat clan bids for Hemedti’s ear, Burhan’s US visa troubles, Kordofan battles come to head as RSF presses ahead in Blue Nile, Kiir re-engineers electoral scene          
        As world leaders gathered in New York this week for talks at the United Nations General Assembly, Transitional Sovereignty Council Chair Abdel Fattah al-Burhan had to watch the proceeding from afar. And that is because, while the military leader had been penciled in to give a speech to the United Nations General Assembly on Thursday, the US denied his visa.
For Sudanese officials familiar with the internal planning, the move doesn’t come as a complete surprise, given that the US had sanctioned Burhan last year and the relationship has become increasingly fractious. But the visa denial is yet another sign of the frustration and polarization that dominates talks over a humanitarian truce, ceasefire and political settlement to Sudan’s war.
Sources in New York and others familiar with communications between Sudan, regional capitals and the US described efforts to mitigate the crisis, which they viewed as US pressure on Sudan to accept a 90-day humanitarian truce, while emphasizing that the government would not back down from its core position.
But the military wasn’t the only one facing a political crisis this week. In Darfur, the Nawaiba, one of the Rizeigat’s main clans in East Darfur, announced it was withdrawing from the nazirate of Musa Madibo, the head of the Rizeigat.
The Nawaib were keen to underline they still support the RSF leadership, who hail from the Rizeigat. According to a Rizeigat tribal leader informed of discussions within several of the tribe’s components, the move is really a bid to open a direct line of communication with RSF Commander Mohamed Hamdan “Hemedti” Dagalo.
Nonetheless, for the RSF, which has already seen internecine fighting among its base, with loyalists jockeying for rungs in the broader hierarchy, the move’s catalytic effect could create an even larger opening for rival military and political actors to exploit the crisis.
Away from political management, Sudan’s two main battlefronts continue to churn. Following weeks of military gains in North Kordofan, fighting is narrowing in on the remaining RSF-held positions. Both sides are upping the ante with front line deployments to try to sway the fight for the state one way or another.
The military holds a much less firm position in the Blue Nile, even as it continues to prevent being overrun. With its eyes set on the state’s capital of Damazin, the RSF unsuccessfully attempted to take key towns that would have allowed it to create linkages in its supply chain between its positions on the southeastern border with Ethiopia and its forces farther south near South Sudan.
As wars engulf its neighbors, South Sudan seems set for its own breaking point. In a continuation of his efforts to marginalize his one-time enemy, one-time co-leader in power former Vice President Riek Machar, Kiir overhauled the country’s electoral process this week, appointing a new elections commission chair, amending the electoral law and dissolving the transitional government.
An opposition source called the move politically biased, saying electoral rules set specific grounds for removing the chair, including proven bias, inability to perform the job or serious misconduct.
Elections are set to be held in December, and while voices in South Sudan and beyond continue to warn that current government practices are widening divides, Kiir continues to press ahead, pushing the country, perhaps, to be yet another blazing front in a region on fire.

deduped_items.body_text:
After seizing Tigray airports, TPLF announces ‘defensive war’ against Ethiopian govt          
        The confrontation between the Tigray regional government and the Ethiopian federal government entered a new phase on Wednesday when Tigrayan forces seized control of the Mekelle, Axum and Shire airports.
Clashes broke out at several locations in the restive northern state, the site of a two-year civil war that concluded in 2022, and in the neighboring Afar region — a development that has pushed the Ethiopian conflict back toward open warfare, four years after the signing of the Pretoria Agreement that ended the previous war between the Tigray People’s Liberation Front and federal forces.
A source in the Tigray regional administration told Mada Masr that the seizure of the airports was part of a military redeployment that began in the early hours of Wednesday, with Tigrayan forces using the airports as facilities of operational importance amid the expanding scope of the fighting.
In the wake of the TPLF takeover, Ethiopian Airlines announced the suspension of flights to the three airports due to the “current situation” in the Tigray region.
A Tigrayan military source noted that Wednesday’s developments followed months of troop buildup and limited skirmishes along the front lines, describing Wednesday’s events as a shift from a phase of mutual pressure to direct confrontation. He added that Tigrayan forces view federal movements as an attempt to alter the military landscape established since the Pretoria Agreement and believe that seizing certain vital sites could prevent federal forces from utilizing the region’s civilian and military infrastructure during ongoing operations.
The federal government framed Wednesday’s events differently. A former security source in Addis Ababa described the movements by the TPLF as a “full-scale attack” on government positions in Afar and Amhara.
While seizing airports does not in itself decide the outcome of the battle, it signals a shift in the nature of operations, a security source in Addis Ababa told Mada Masr. Mekelle serves as the region’s political and administrative hub, while the airports at Axum and Shire provide crucial links to northern and western Tigray. Consequently, placing airports under the control of regional forces strains the federal government’s ability to manage its presence within the region and gives Tigrayan forces a strategic advantage in any future negotiations, the source said.
The security source added that any operation to retake the airports would require careful calculation due to the presence of civilians in the cities, and because the use of air power and artillery in urban areas would heighten humanitarian risks.
In its first official comment on Wednesday’s escalation, the Ethiopian military said it had repelled attacks from Tigrayan forces and their allies in parts of northern Ethiopia, adding that hostilities began in an area of the Amhara region close to the border with Tigray.
The military added that it had killed 272 Tigrayan fighters and wounded 260 in a counteroffensive in the Amhara region.
Wednesday’s escalation in the long simmering tension between the TPLF and federal government immediately follows a series of airstrikes that targeted areas in Tigray over the past few days. In Alamata, located in southern Tigray, an attack on Tuesday left 14 civilians dead and 22 injured, a local media source told Mada Masr.
The source stated that more than six drones and three fighter jets carried out over 21 raids, beginning around 3:30 am, adding that the strikes hit civilian educational facilities, including a secondary school.
The media source noted that the area has recently seen an increase in military activity and troop movements involving both federal and Tigrayan forces.

deduped_items.title: IMC, Corporate Stack Solutions sign pact to accelerate SME digitalisation
deduped_items.summary: The Industrial Modernisation Center (IMC) has signed a cooperation protocol with Corporate Stack Solutions, a company specialising in digital consulting and applications, to support the digital transformation of Egyptian industrial companies, particularly small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). The agreement was signed by Ayman Elbayaa, Executive Director of the IMC, and Mohamed Abdeen, CEO of Corporate […] The post IMC, Corporate Stack Solutions sign pact to accelerate SME digitalisation fir
deduped_items.body_text:
The Industrial Modernisation Center (IMC) has signed a cooperation protocol with Corporate Stack Solutions, a company specialising in digital consulting and applications, to support the digital transformation of Egyptian industrial companies, particularly small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs).
The agreement was signed by Ayman Elbayaa, Executive Director of the IMC, and Mohamed Abdeen, CEO of Corporate Stack Solutions, in the presence of representatives from both sides and officials from the industrial and information technology sectors.
The protocol aims to enable local industrial companies to adopt enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems and advanced digital applications through locally developed software-as-a-service (SaaS) solutions based on monthly subscriptions.
The initiative is intended to improve factories’ operational efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance their competitiveness in local and international markets, as part of Egypt’s efforts to accelerate digital transformation and the adoption of Industry 4.0 technologies.
IMC Executive Director Ayman Elbayaa said the cooperation reinforces a “three-way partnership model” between the IMC, the technology developer, and beneficiary companies, adding that the centre is focused on raising the level of digital maturity across the industrial sector.
He added that the IMC will provide technical and supervisory support, as well as a package of facilities under the partnership, to help ensure the successful and sustainable implementation of digital transformation within factories.
For his part, Corporate Stack Solutions CEO Mohamed Abdeen said the company would provide locally developed software solutions and customised packages at preferential costs for IMC clients.
The company will also commit to a 60- to 90-day timeline for installation, implementation, and training, in addition to providing continuous technical support to factories throughout the contract period, he said.
Abdeen said digital transformation should not be limited to large companies, noting that SMEs also need efficient tools to manage their resources, operations, and data, but through simpler solutions suited to their business models and capabilities.
He pointed out that the partnership with the IMC provides an opportunity to implement this approach on a wider scale, adding that the objective extends beyond providing factories with technology to offering an integrated transformation process.
This process will start with identifying each factory’s needs and continue through implementation, training, and operation, ultimately enabling companies to use digital tools effectively in their day-to-day operations and achieve measurable business results.

deduped_items.title: Joe Wilson to Al-Modon: Sharaa Is Reconnecting Syria With the World
deduped_items.summary: U.S. Congressman Joe Wilson praised the transformation underway in Syria in a statement to Al-Modon, saying that Syria’s positive presence on the international stage mattered greatly to Syrians and to Syrian-Americans. Mr Wilson was commenting on President Ahmad Al-Sharaa’s visit to New York to attend the 81st session of the U.N. General Assembly, his third […] The post Joe Wilson to Al-Modon: Sharaa Is Reconnecting Syria With the World first appeared on The Syrian Observer.
deduped_items.body_text:
U.S. Congressman Joe Wilson praised the transformation underway in Syria in a statement to Al-Modon, saying that Syria’s positive presence on the international stage mattered greatly to Syrians and to Syrian-Americans.
Mr Wilson was commenting on President Ahmad Al-Sharaa’s visit to New York to attend the 81st session of the U.N. General Assembly, his third visit to the United States since taking office.
He affirmed U.S. support for President Sharaa’s efforts to reconnect Syria with the world and to promote peace and prosperity.
Syria Regains Its International Presence
“It is extremely important for Syrians and Syrian-Americans to see their country, once a pariah because of the former regime, represented positively on the world stage,” Mr Wilson said. He added: “President Sharaa is helping reconnect Syria with the world, and America supports his efforts to promote peace and prosperity.”
In New York, President Sharaa is holding four days of high-level meetings with leaders and diplomats on the sidelines of the General Assembly, most notably an expected meeting with U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio.
A Supportive Voice for Syria in Congress
In recent months, Mr Wilson has backed improved U.S. relations with Syria and pushed Washington to ease economic and political restrictions on the country, while also calling for Syria’s stability to be protected and for an end to airstrikes on Syrian territory.
In his latest statement, Mr Wilson called for a halt to Israeli airstrikes on Syria, saying that they undermined the stabilisation process Washington sought to support.
In a series of posts on X, he said he appreciated U.S. Envoy to Syria Tom Barrack’s opposition to the strikes. Asked whether he was explicitly calling for them to stop, he replied: “Absolutely.”
Mr Wilson linked this position to the need to give Syria a chance to consolidate stability, peace and prosperity, arguing that the success of this process would benefit not only Syria but the wider region.
His efforts have not been limited to political statements. Over the past period, he has worked within Congress to remove legal and economic obstacles to Syria’s opening to the world.
In June, Mr Wilson called on the U.S. Department of State to remove Syria’s designation as a “State Sponsor of Terrorism” and to lower the U.S. travel advisory for the country, arguing that developments in Syria warranted a review of U.S. policy to reflect the new reality.
He said that, in his assessment, Syria had taken historic steps towards peace and prosperity and had cooperated with the United States on the regional agenda and counterterrorism.
Mr Wilson also acted on sanctions. In 2025, he introduced an amendment in Congress to repeal the Caesar Act, saying it was time to give Syria a chance.
The Caesar Act was repealed in December 2025 as part of the U.S. National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA) for fiscal year 2026.

deduped_items.title: Drone debris found near Moldovan village
deduped_items.summary: Moldovan border guards discovered pieces of an unidentified drone in Ștefan Vodă District on 26 September, hours after another unidentified drone entered the country's airspace amid Russian attacks on Ukraine.
deduped_items.body_text:
Drone debris found near Moldovan village
On the evening of 26 September, Moldovan border guards discovered debris of an unmanned aerial vehicle outside the village of Volintiri in Ștefan Vodă District.
Source: Moldova's Border Police
Details: Pieces of an unidentified drone were discovered at around 20:25 after local residents alerted the authorities.
Border guards immediately cordoned off the area. The necessary measures are currently being taken to establish all the circumstances surrounding the incident.
Moldova's Border Police said that, in cooperation with other competent authorities, it was continuously monitoring the situation and maintaining contact with the relevant Ukrainian authorities.
Law enforcement officers urged the public not to approach or touch possible pieces of aircraft, ammunition or other unidentified objects. Anyone who discovers such objects is advised to move away from the area and immediately call 112.
It is worth noting that earlier the same day, amid Russian attacks on Ukraine, an unidentified drone illegally entered Moldovan airspace. The object reportedly entered the country's airspace at 11:16, approaching from the direction of Stepanivka in Odesa Oblast, Ukraine, and crossed the state border towards Novokotovsk in the unrecognised breakaway region of Transnistria.
At 11:18, the object left Moldovan airspace, crossing the border towards Lymanske in Odesa Oblast.
It was also reported that an unidentified object violated Romanian airspace overnight on 26 September, prompting allied fighter jets to be scrambled.
On 18 September, police found drone fragments near Chișinău.

deduped_items.title: Putin Accuses Kyiv of Striking Polling Stations: ‘We Were Ready to Resume Negotiations’
deduped_items.summary: Speaking to reporters on Friday, Russian President Vladimir Putin again pinned the blame for stalled diplomacy on Ukraine, saying Moscow was ready to resume negotiations after its Sept. 18-20 State Duma elections. He claimed Ukraine attacked the country’s polling stations, and added that the proposals for a peaceful settlement still exist – after the Kremlin decides “what is in its interests.” Putin’s remarks came as Washington stepped up its effort to broker an end to the war.

deduped_items.title: Бывшая пресс-секретарь президента Украины рассказала о растрате денег для военных
deduped_items.body_text:
У Украины были 3,6 миллиарда долларов для обеспечения зарплаты военным по контрактам, но их растратили. Об этом в социальной сети X рассказала бывшая пресс-секретарь президента Украины Юлия Мендель.
«Для обеспечения 360 тысяч контрактов для украинских мужчин по десять тысяч долларов на каждого потребовалось бы 3,6 миллиарда долларов. Украина располагала этими деньгами, но, скорее всего, они были просто украдены», — заявила Мендель.
Она добавила, что украинские власти предпочитают методы насильственной мобилизации привлечению мужчин на фронт с помощью вознаграждения.
Ранее Мендель заявила, что ежегодная сумма взяток, которые украинцы дают сотрудникам военкоматов, чтобы избежать отправки на передовую, может доходить до пяти миллиардов долларов.

deduped_items.title: Стало известно о сбросе начиненных монетами взрывных устройств ВСУ
deduped_items.body_text:
Вооруженные силы Украины (ВСУ) начали сбрасывать в Херсонской области при помощи дронов взрывные устройства, начиненные монетами по одной гривне. Об этом сообщил глава Каховского округа Павел Филипчук, его слова приводит ТАСС.
«Саперные группы во время инженерной разведки в Каховском округе выявляют пластмассовые СВУ, начиненные взрывчаткой, электродетонатором и украинскими монетами номиналом одна гривна», — рассказал Филипчук.
Чиновник отметил, что монеты служат в качестве кумулятивной выемки и поражающих элементов. Местные саперы успешно обезвреживают такие боеприпасы.
Ранее украинские военные использовали беспилотник с поражающими элементами в ходе очередной атаки на Севастополь. В результате детонации беспилотника никто не пострадал, однако повреждения получили пять машин и окна в доме.

deduped_items.body_text:
Согласно предварительным результатам референдума, почти 70 процентов швейцарцев выступили против ужесточения принципа нейтралитета в конституции государства. Данные публикует федеральный портал VoteInfo.
68,70 процента проголосовали против, а 31,30 процента поддержали инициативу. Явка составила 46,60 процента.
25 сентября стало известно, что в случае принятия решения об ужесточении нейтралитета Швейцария фактически запретит себе самостоятельно вводить санкции против РФ.
11 сентября президент России Владимир Путин заявил, что Запад применяет незаконные ограничения и угрожает вторичными санкциями странам, которые защищают свои национальные интересы.
Кроме того, Путин отмечал, что в отношении России было введено свыше 30 тысяч санкций, что почти вдвое больше, чем число ограничений против всех остальных стран мира, вместе взятых.

deduped_items.title: В Кировограде прогремел новый взрыв
deduped_items.body_text:
Краткий пересказ от РИА ИИ
- В Кировограде прогремел взрыв на фоне воздушной тревоги.
- По данным онлайн-карты украинского министерства цифровой трансформации, в части Кировоградской области звучит сигнал воздушной тревоги.
МОСКВА, 27 сен - РИА Новости. Взрыв вновь прогремел в Кировограде на фоне воздушной тревоги, сообщает украинский телеканал "Общественное". 
Ранее украинские СМИ сообщали о взрывах в городе. 
"В Кропивницком (название Кировограда после переименования украинскими властями - ред.) слышен звук взрыва", - говорится в сообщении в Telegram-канале "Общественного". 
По данным онлайн-карты украинского министерства цифровой трансформации, в части Кировоградской области звучит сигнал воздушной тревоги.

deduped_items.title: Захарова объяснила, зачем глава МИД ФРГ просил о встрече с Лавровым
deduped_items.body_text:
Краткий пересказ от РИА ИИ
- Глава МИД Германии Йоханн Вадефуль запросил переговоры с Сергеем Лавровым, чтобы показать дипломатическую активность, заявила Мария Захарова.
- Она добавила, что запрос на встречу был также, чтобы поправить рейтинг Мерца.
МОСКВА, 27 сен-РИА Новости. Глава МИД Германии Йоханн Вадефуль запросил переговоры с главой МИД России Сергеем Лавровым на полях Генсаамблеи ООН, чтобы показать дипломатическую активность, рассказала РИА Новости официальный представитель МИД России Мария Захарова. 
"Вадефуль запросил переговоры с Лавровым, чтобы показать дипломатическую активность и поправить подающий рейтинг Мерца", - сказала она.

deduped_items.title: Расчет "Панциря-С" уничтожил три "Фламинго", летевшие на Москву 20 сентября
deduped_items.body_text:
Краткий пересказ от РИА ИИ
- Расчет зенитного ракетно-пушечного комплекса «Панцирь-С» уничтожил три крылатые ракеты «Фламинго», летевшие на Москву, в ночь с 19 на 20 сентября.
- Расчеты ПВО сбили в общей сложности 1,6 тысячи воздушных целей, из них восемь высокоскоростных реактивных крылатых ракет «Фламинго».
МОСКВА, 27 сен - РИА Новости. Расчет зенитного ракетно-пушечного комплекса "Панцирь-С" уничтожил три крылатые ракеты "Фламинго", летевшие на Москву, в ночь с 19 на 20 сентября, сообщил командир расчета с позывным Барнаул. 
По данным Минобороны РФ, в ночь с 19 на 20 сентября расчеты ПВО сбили 1,6 тысячи воздушных целей, из них восемь высокоскоростных реактивных крылатых ракет "Фламинго". 
«
"В ходе несения боевого дежурства расчетом нашей боевой машины было уничтожено восемь воздушных целей, из них три крылатые ракеты типа "Фламинго", - сказал Барнаул на видео, опубликованном Минобороны.
В ведомстве отметили, что уничтожение трех таких ракет подряд одним расчетом стало первым случаем за всю историю атак на Москву.

deduped_items.title: Un abbraccio rimasto intatto per secoli: madre e figlio ritrovati nel cimitero medievale a Foggia
deduped_items.summary: Nel quartiere dell’antico porto di Siponto, vicino a Manfredonia, gli archeologi hanno scoperto un cimitero medievale con una trentina di sepolture allineate. Tra queste, i resti di una donna tra i 30 e i 40 anni deposta con il braccio destro intorno a un bambino di circa 4 o 5 anni: una disposizione che fa pensare a una madre con il figlio, anche se saranno le analisi antropologiche a verificare il legame. Il ritrovamento è avvenuto durante la sesta campagna di scavi condotta dalle Università d

Ungió como candidato a su hijo Flávio, una copia devaluada y sin carisma que, aun así, empata con Lula en las encuestas de las elecciones del 4 de octubre. El bolsonarismo resiste, entre otros factores, porque mantiene en el centro de su discurso las cuestiones morales y demoniza a la izquierda, presentándola como una amenaza a la fe y la famila

Ungió como candidato a su hijo Flávio, una copia devaluada y sin carisma que, aun así, empata con Lula en las encuestas de las elecciones del 4 de octubre. El bolsonarismo resiste, entre otros factores, porque mantiene en el centro de su discurso las cuestiones morales y demoniza a la izquierda, presentándola como una amenaza a la fe y la famila

deduped_items.body_text:
El Papa busca en Francia la reconciliación entre la Iglesia y las víctimas de abusos sexuales
Tras la misa multitudinaria de París, León XIV se da otro baño de masas en Lourdes, donde se reúne esta tarde con personas agredidas sexualmente por religiosos
Corresponsal en París
Tras la misa multitudinaria del sábado en la Plaza de la Concordia en París, el Papa León XIV se ha dado este domingo otro baño de masas en Lourdes, en el suroeste de Francia. Esta pequeña localidad de peregrinaje, cercana al País Vasco galo, ... se ha llenado de fieles para asistir a una misa al aire libre oficiada por el Pontífice. Según el Vaticano, unos 150.000 creyentes han asistido a la ceremonia, que ha dejado de nuevo impresionantes imágenes aéreas de un público numeroso. Durante esta segunda etapa del viaje por el territorio galo, el Pontífice ha dado una importancia particular al apoyo a las víctimas de violencia sexual en el seno de la Iglesia.
Antes de encabezar el acto en la explanada de Lourdes, cercana a la basílica del Rosario, el Papa presidió una reunión con obispos y arzobispos. Durante ese encuentro, les pidió que «continuaran» con las acciones contra la «lacra» de los abusos cometidos por religiosos, según algunos participantes en ese encuentro, celebrado sin la presencia de medios de comunicación.
«Ha destacado el trabajo hecho por la Iglesia (…) y le ha pedido que siga mejorando en ese sentido», ha explicado a la cadena France 2 Grégoire Drouot, obispo de Nevers. Tras verse salpicada por numerosos escándalos, la institución eclesiástica gala impulsó en 2020 una ambiciosa iniciativa para reconocer el elevadísimo número de víctimas (hasta 320.000 desde 1950) e indemnizarlas. También creó dos comisiones para escuchar la palabra de los agredidos, muchos de ellos cuando eran niños o adolescentes. Y destinó 44 millones de euros para indemnizar a 1.193 de ellos durante los últimos cinco años, indicó esta semana uno de estos organismos independientes.
Noticia relacionada
- 
Una lección que conmueve a Europa Javier Martínez-Brocal
El Pontífice estadounidense y peruano también ha homenajeado a estas víctimas meditando delante de la fotografía del 'Niño que llora'. Esta imagen se expone en el santuario de Lourdes desde hace cinco años para homenajear a los menores de edad que sufrieron abusos dentro de la Iglesia. Otro gesto para respetar a los agredidos ha sido la decisión de cubrir los mosaicos de Marko Rupnik que hay en la fachada de la monumental basílica del Rosario. Hasta 20 mujeres han acusado a este padre y artista esloveno de haber abusado de ellas, a nivel sexual o psicológico.
Las menciones a la lacra de la violencia sexual también han estado presentes durante la misa dominical de Robert Prevost. «La exigencia de conversión compromete a la propia Iglesia en su peregrinación terrenal. Para sanar las profundas heridas, las infidelidades y los dolorosos extravíos cometidos en su seno, debemos someternos humildemente a la mirada purificadora del Señor», ha asegurado durante la lectura de una homilía, mayoritariamente en francés. «Es indispensable reconocer nuestras propias faltas para nuestro progreso espiritual», ha añadido durante el acto central de su paso por Lourdes, donde no había venido ningún Santo Padre desde Benedicto XVI en 2008. Han acudido numerosos fieles franceses, pero también españoles y de otros países.
«Es indispensable reconocer nuestras propias faltas para nuestro progreso espiritual»
León XIV
Papa
León XIV también ha aprovechado la misa para insistir en sus críticas en contra de la eutanasia, legalizada en Francia a finales de julio para los enfermos terminales que lo deseen de manera voluntaria. «Frente a las corrientes actuales que pretenden redefinir el valor de la vida humana ante la enfermedad, el sufrimiento o la vejez, la gruta de Massabielle se erige como un santuario de la esperanza cristiana», ha afirmado. deduped_items.body_text:
El Cristo del Valle vuelve a reunir a Tembleque en una romería que mantiene viva su devoción centenaria
La romería del Cristo del Valle de Tembleque reúne a vecinos, familias y peregrinos de distintos municipios de Castilla-La Mancha
TOLEDO
Tembleque ha vuelto a reunirse este domingo, 27 de septiembre, en torno al Cristo del Valle, patrón popular de la localidad, en una romería que mantiene viva una tradición profundamente arraigada entre varias generaciones. La ermita del Santísimo Cristo del Valle, también conocido como ... Cristo de la Palma, ha vuelto a ser punto de encuentro para vecinos y peregrinos llegados de distintos municipios de Castilla-La Mancha.
Desde primera hora, los caminos y los alrededores del santuario han recuperado el movimiento habitual de esta jornada. Familias enteras, vecinos de Tembleque y peregrinos que han llegado a pie han participado en una celebración que combina el carácter religioso con el encuentro popular y que forma parte del calendario sentimental de la localidad.
La devoción al Cristo del Valle está vinculada desde hace generaciones a la historia cotidiana de Tembleque. Fotografías antiguas, recuerdos familiares, promesas y visitas al santuario forman parte de una relación que, en muchos casos, comienza en la infancia y se prolonga durante toda la vida.
Noticia relacionada
El carácter de patrón popular de la localidad responde precisamente a ese vínculo construido con el paso del tiempo. No se trata únicamente de una denominación religiosa, sino de una referencia compartida por los vecinos, que ha adquirido también reconocimiento institucional con el nombramiento de la venerada imagen como Alcalde Honorífico.
La romería de septiembre vuelve a poner de manifiesto ese arraigo. Algunos asistentes han recorrido varios kilómetros caminando para llegar hasta la ermita, mientras otros han regresado a Tembleque desde fuera de la localidad para mantener una cita familiar que se repite año tras año.
Entre los asistentes también se encuentran fieles procedentes de Turleque, Villanueva de Bogas y Mora, además de vecinos llegados desde otros puntos de Castilla-La Mancha. La presencia de peregrinos de municipios cercanos confirma que la devoción al Cristo del Valle trasciende las fronteras de Tembleque y mantiene una dimensión comarcal.
El camino hasta la ermita constituye, para muchos peregrinos, una parte esencial de la propia celebración. Se recorre por una promesa, por devoción, por tradición familiar o simplemente porque es una costumbre transmitida de padres a hijos. Las motivaciones son diferentes, pero el destino es el mismo.
La continuidad de esta tradición adquiere especial significado en un contexto de cambios sociales, emigración y despoblación rural. Muchos vecinos que ya no residen habitualmente en Tembleque mantienen la romería entre sus motivos para regresar al municipio en estas fechas.
La ermita, situada en las proximidades del embalse de Finisterre, forma parte de esa memoria colectiva. No es únicamente el escenario de las dos romerías anuales, sino un espacio vinculado al paisaje y a la historia de varias generaciones de temblequeños.
La localidad celebra una primera romería el segundo domingo de mayo y una segunda el último domingo de septiembre. Ambas fechas marcan el calendario del santuario, aunque para numerosos vecinos la relación con el Cristo se prolonga durante todo el año.
Detrás de cada jornada de romería existe, además, un trabajo permanente de la Hermandad del Cristo del Valle y de la parroquia de Tembleque. La organización de las celebraciones, la atención religiosa del santuario y el mantenimiento de las tradiciones requieren una dedicación que se extiende mucho más allá de los días de mayor afluencia.

Al Caja 87 se le hizo demasiado largo el partido en el Movistar Arena (78-65)
El conjunto sevillano clavó hasta el intermedio un plan de juego que saltó por los aires en el segundo tiempo entre la mejoría del Estudiantes, los tiros libres y su atasco ofensivo
El Caja 87 ya sabe lo que le espera en Primera FEB en todos los sentidos. Esta liga es otra dimensión, más compleja incluso cuando toca visitar canchas como el Movistar Arena, donde mora un candidato a la ACB de gran potencial y muy respetado ... que lleva cinco años en la categoría. Con un plan de juego muy medido y calculado al que sacó máximo rendimiento en la primera parte, basado en la firmeza defensiva y un bajo ritmo de juego para que el partido no se desmadrase en puntos ni en posesiones, el Caja 87 alcanzó con ventaja el descanso.
Luego, todo cambió. El goteo de faltas afligió mentalmente al equipo de Juani Díez, el Estudiantes afinó en el tiro, mejoró su defensa y, poco a poco, el Caja 87 se adentró en un túnel sin salida que lo llevó al colapso y la derrota. Llegó a perder de 20 aunque maquillase al final. Perdió la batalla por el rebote y tiene razones para hacer autocrítica pero también para lamentarse: el Estudiantes lanzó 23 tiros libres más. Un factor diferencial en un partido muy parejo hasta el descanso que mostró la personalidad de un recién ascendido al que se le hizo demasiado largo su debut.
Bolavie anotó desde el tiro libre el primer punto del Caja 87 en Primera FEB y fue Treier, en rebote de ataque, el que acertaba la primera canasta en tiro de campo de un partido espeso en sus compases iniciales, sin acierto colegial en el lanzamiento exterior y con los verdirrojos jugando largo, con paciencia y a media pista, pero igualmente negados. Persiana bajada. Tras cuatro minutos, 4-3, y cumplidos los ocho, un pírrico 9-5 en el electrónico.
A excepción de Bolavie, ya había cambiado el técnico argentino a todo el quinteto de un Caja 87 al que ese bajo ritmo de producción, a priori, no le venía mal, todo lo contrario. Era, de hecho, el plan. Cecilia, por la calle central y tras robo, machacaba el aro estudiantil (10-9), pero luego una pérdida del ursaonense provocó el 12-9 de Speight que zanjó un primer cuarto igualado y de mínimos, con los hispalenses a tiro de triple, faceta del juego en la que estaban por estrenarse.
Con Varela y Soumbey-Alley a los mandos de nuevo, Latorre anotaba por duplicado en el arranque del segundo cuarto y Cecilia, quién si no, respondía a un triple de Treier desde su esquina favorita, la izquierda del ataque (17-16). Lo paró Toni Ten porque el Caja 87, firme y consistente, sólido y sin complejos, le estaba compitiendo de tú a tú a su equipo. Moody culminaba un trabajado ataque cajista y Mendikote, desde el tiro libre, restaba hasta el 21-19. El rebote defensivo se estaba convirtiendo en un lunar y Webster, falta infantil la suya, regalaba un adicional a Treier que el estonio afortunadamente erraba. Moody, estelar en el tiro, nivelaba el marcador (26-26) con un triple mirando a otro lado. Entonces, Juani Díez puso a Rafa García de zapa sobre Silverio, la más peligrosa fuente de alimentación colegial.
Moody y Cecilia, líderes al intermedio
A 1.40, Cecilia colocaba el 27-28. Apretaba el Caja 87 en defensa, subiendo líneas y siendo agresivo, sin descuidarse en el uno contra uno y evitando que la rotación de balón colegial hallase tiros liberados. La tela de araña seguía tejiéndose. Poco a poco. Cecilia anotaba un canastón lateral con mucho arco para superar la defensa rival, Moody se retiraba al banco tras un golpe en la zona abdominal en un bloqueo con Floyd, Cecilia clavaba un nuevo triple (28-33) y Millán Jiménez dejaba el 30-33 al intermedio. Con 12 y 9 puntos respectivamente, Cecilia y Moody lideraban la ofensiva del Caja 87, que había concedido 10 rebotes de ataque a un Estudiantes maniatado: un pobre 35% en el tiro de campo acreditaba.
Webster abría su cuenta triplista en el despegue del tercer cuarto (32-36) mientr

El Papa busca en Francia la reconciliación entre la Iglesia y las víctimas de abusos sexuales
Tras la misa multitudinaria de París, León XIV se da otro baño de masas en Lourdes, donde se reúne esta tarde con personas agredidas sexualmente por religiosos
Corresponsal en París
Tras la misa multitudinaria del sábado en la Plaza de la Concordia en París, el Papa León XIV se ha dado este domingo otro baño de masas en Lourdes, en el suroeste de Francia. Esta pequeña localidad de peregrinaje, cercana al País Vasco galo, ... se ha llenado de fieles para asistir a una misa al aire libre oficiada por el Pontífice. Según el Vaticano, unos 150.000 creyentes han asistido a la ceremonia, que ha dejado de nuevo impresionantes imágenes aéreas de un público numeroso. Durante esta segunda etapa del viaje por el territorio galo, el Pontífice ha dado una importancia particular al apoyo a las víctimas de violencia sexual en el seno de la Iglesia.
Antes de encabezar el acto en la explanada de Lourdes, cercana a la basílica del Rosario, el Papa presidió una reunión con obispos y arzobispos. Durante ese encuentro, les pidió que «continuaran» con las acciones contra la «lacra» de los abusos cometidos por religiosos, según algunos participantes en ese encuentro, celebrado sin la presencia de medios de comunicación.
«Ha destacado el trabajo hecho por la Iglesia (…) y le ha pedido que siga mejorando en ese sentido», ha explicado a la cadena France 2 Grégoire Drouot, obispo de Nevers. Tras verse salpicada por numerosos escándalos, la institución eclesiástica gala impulsó en 2020 una ambiciosa iniciativa para reconocer el elevadísimo número de víctimas (hasta 320.000 desde 1950) e indemnizarlas. También creó dos comisiones para escuchar la palabra de los agredidos, muchos de ellos cuando eran niños o adolescentes. Y destinó 44 millones de euros para indemnizar a 1.193 de ellos durante los últimos cinco años, indicó esta semana uno de estos organismos independientes.

El Pontífice estadounidense y peruano también ha homenajeado a estas víctimas meditando delante de la fotografía del 'Niño que llora'. Esta imagen se expone en el santuario de Lourdes desde hace cinco años para homenajear a los menores de edad que sufrieron abusos dentro de la Iglesia. Otro gesto para respetar a los agredidos ha sido la decisión de cubrir los mosaicos de Marko Rupnik que hay en la fachada de la monumental basílica del Rosario. Hasta 20 mujeres han acusado a este padre y artista esloveno de haber abusado de ellas, a nivel sexual o psicológico.
Las menciones a la lacra de la violencia sexual también han estado presentes durante la misa dominical de Robert Prevost. «La exigencia de conversión compromete a la propia Iglesia en su peregrinación terrenal. Para sanar las profundas heridas, las infidelidades y los dolorosos extravíos cometidos en su seno, debemos someternos humildemente a la mirada purificadora del Señor», ha asegurado durante la lectura de una homilía, mayoritariamente en francés. «Es indispensable reconocer nuestras propias faltas para nuestro progreso espiritual», ha añadido durante el acto central de su paso por Lourdes, donde no había venido ningún Santo Padre desde Benedicto XVI en 2008. Han acudido numerosos fieles franceses, pero también españoles y de otros países.
«Es indispensable reconocer nuestras propias faltas para nuestro progreso espiritual»

Papa

deduped_items.title: Late September heat might break Dutch records as highs set to reach 28°C midweek
deduped_items.summary: Unusually high temperatures for late September are expected across the Netherlands this week, with highs of 25-28 degrees Celcius in many areas.
deduped_items.body_text:
Late September heat might break Dutch records as highs set to reach 28°C midweek
Unusually high temperatures for late September are expected across the Netherlands this week, with highs of 25-28 degrees Celcius in many areas. According to Weeronline, several heat records could therefore fall. Showers moving in from the west Wednesday evening will push the warmth out and may produce thunderstorms. After that, highs are to settle near 20 degrees, with Thursday set to be the cloudiest and the wettest day.
On Monday, temperatures are likely to reach 25 degrees in Limburg. The west and north will see the highs between 19 and 20 degrees, with occasional light rain and ample clouds. Temperatures will range from 21 to 24 degrees from Utrecht to Enschede.
Tuesday and Wednesday will be even warmer all over the country. The temperatures will climb above 25 degrees in large parts of the country. It could also get up to 30 degrees locally.
Late September normally averages around 17 degrees, making current warmth remarkable, the weather service notes. De Bilt, where the national measurements are taken, has never recorded 25 degrees on the last days of September. This week, therefore, could break several temperature records.
The weather pattern is set to change Wednesday evening. Showers will push in from the west, driving out the heat. The thunderstorms will also be possible.
The rest of the week is likely to be mild. Under a mix of sun and clouds, the temperature highs are set to stay around 20 degrees. Thursday is set to experience the most clouds and rain.

deduped_items.title: Polish president “doesn’t like” Trump inviting Putin to G20 but will still attend summit
deduped_items.summary: "If it were up to us, Russia should be isolated in all international forums," says President Nawrocki's chief foreign policy aide.
deduped_items.body_text:
Keep our news free from ads and paywalls by making a donation to support our work!
Notes from Poland is run by a small editorial team and is published by an independent, non-profit foundation that is funded through donations from our readers. We cannot do what we do without your support.
Polish President Karol Nawrocki “does not like” the fact that the Trump administration has invited Vladimir Putin to this year’s G20 summit in the United States, says his chief foreign policy aide.
However, Nawrocki, who is a close ally of Donald Trump, still plans to attend the event – which Poland has been invited to as a guest rather than a full G20 member – in order to represent Polish interests and push for full membership of the group.
🔴 "Nie podoba nam się to". Nawrocki ma problem po decyzji Trumpa
Prezydent Karol Nawrocki weźmie udział w grudniowym szczycie G20 w Miami, na który zaproszono również Władimira Putina. Szef Biura Polityki Międzynarodowej Kancelarii Prezydenta Marcin Przydacz przyznał na antenie…
— Wirtualna Polska (@wirtualnapolska) September 26, 2026
The G20, a major intergovernmental forum, holds an annual summit whose location rotates among members. This year’s event will take place in December at a golf resort in Miami owned by Trump.
On Wednesday this week, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced that Trump has invited Putin to attend the summit, saying that “we think it’s an opportunity for him to engage…with other world leaders” and “we hope that’s an invitation he’ll accept”.
“If you only meet with people that you agree with, then these are very nice meetings but nothing happens,” added Rubio. “In order to solve problems, you have to meet with people that you disagree with or the people that you might have some issues with.”
Marco Rubio on Russia:
We’ve invited President Putin to the G20. We think it’s an opportunity for him to engage not just with Trump, but with other world leaders.
We hope that’s an invitation he will accept. pic.twitter.com/e0GSz7Y8gm
— Clash Report (@clashreport) September 23, 2026
Last December, Rubio also announced Poland’s invitation to the summit as a guest, saying that it would be “assuming its rightful place in the G20”. In May this year, the US also “expressed its strong support for Poland’s accession to the G20 as a permanent member”.
Poland will be represented by Nawrocki, who is a vocal critic of Putin and Russia, and is himself on a Russian wanted list for his work leading efforts to demolish Soviet-era monuments in Poland.
In an interview on Sunday with news website Wirtualna Polska, the head of Nawrocki’s international policy office, Marcin Przydacz, was asked if the US was right to invite Putin. “We don’t like it,” he replied.
“But we were invited to the G20 summit as guests, and it’s not our role to tell the participants who should be part of it,” he added, noting that Russia is a founding member of the G20. However, “if it were up to us, Russia should be isolated in all international forums.”
Nevertheless, “President [Nawrocki] is going to Miami and doesn’t intend to change his plans at this stage”, confirmed Przydacz. “Poland will be at the G20 summit because it’s in our interest…This isn’t the only format in which we sit with countries we disagree with.”
However, he also added that, “if the Russian leader actually intends to come, and is not just invited, we will discuss this with our European and Euro-Atlantic allies”.
Putin has not attended a G20 summit in person since 2019, initially due to the COVID-19 pandemic and later amid the fallout from Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine and the International Criminal Court’s arrest warrant against him. The US is not a member of the ICC, so the arrest warrant does not apply on its territory.
Przydacz told Wirtualna Polska that Putin “should be held accountable for his crimes”. Asked if Nawrocki would shake hands with the Russian president at the G20, Przydacz said that he “doesn’t think any interactions will occur”.

deduped_items.body_text:
Vucic announces pardons and plans to abolish proceedings against Novi Sad activists
Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic said Sunday that he plans to issue pardons and decisions abolishing criminal proceedings against some people over events in the country during the past year and a half, saying the measures would apply to people âon both sides.â
Oglas
Vucic, who has announced that he will resign as president on Sunday evening, told Serbiaâs public broadcaster RTS that he was still working on the decisions.
âI am referring to some of the people who participated in everything that has happened in the country over the past year and a half, on both sides. Many will be surprised by the pardons and abolition decisions,â Vucic said.
He said one type of decision would apply to people who have already been convicted and another to those who have not, arguing that the measures would contribute to âa more peaceful life and better understanding among everyone.â
âI also felt sorry for some of those who spent seven or eight months in detention because of me and who held public office, so I will help them as well,â Vucic said.
He also said he intended to abolish proceedings against what he called the âNovi Sad group,â referring to activists including Mila Pajic.
âI am talking about all these blockaders, the Pajic group,â Vucic said.
Vucic later added that he would consult judicial authorities and examine the legal options available before making the decision, saying the public would be informed on Monday. He acknowledged that the move could cause dissatisfaction among his supporters.
The Novi Sad group includes students and activists who have been charged with attempting to overthrow the constitutional order. Six were arrested in March 2025, while another six activists, including Pajic, were abroad at the time and remain outside Serbia.

The companies plan to develop the vehicles for SAE Level 4 autonomous driving, which allows vehic
deduped_items.body_text:
Bolt and Lucid Plan 25,000 Autonomous Vehicles Across Europe
Prague Morning
Bolt and U.S. electric vehicle maker Lucid Group have announced a partnership to develop autonomous mobility services in Europe, with plans to deploy more than 25,000 fully autonomous vehicles across European cities over the coming years.
The vehicles will be based on Lucid’s upcoming Midsize platform and use NVIDIA Hyperion, a reference architecture and development platform for autonomous vehicles.
The companies plan to develop the vehicles for SAE Level 4 autonomous driving, which allows vehicles to operate without human control within defined conditions.
Bolt says the project is part of its wider ambition to have 100,000 autonomous vehicles operating on its platform by 2035.
The companies will work together from the early stages of vehicle development. Bolt will contribute traffic and mobility data, operational experience and knowledge of European markets, while Lucid will provide its software-defined vehicle platform and automotive technology.
Bolt will also define requirements covering the vehicle, software, safety and passenger experience. Its autonomous driving division will oversee the partnership and develop the infrastructure needed to operate the fleet.
This will include vehicle dispatch, charging, maintenance, remote assistance and customer support. Bolt also plans to own and operate the autonomous vehicles itself.
Rollout will depend on local regulations
The companies have not yet announced which European cities will receive the service first.
Bolt and Lucid said launches will take place city by city and depend on local regulations, official approvals and operational readiness. The companies also plan to work with autonomous driving technology providers, European regulators and policymakers before introducing the service.
For the foreseeable future, autonomous vehicles on the Bolt platform will operate alongside vehicles driven by human drivers.
Lucid’s side of the project will be led by Lucid Technologies, a newly established division bringing together artificial intelligence, advanced driver-assistance systems, autonomous driving and other digital technologies.
Bolt currently operates in more than 850 cities across 50 countries and says its platform serves more than 200 million customers. Its services include ride-hailing, car-sharing, electric scooters and food and grocery delivery.
Lucid Group, listed on the Nasdaq under the ticker LCID, develops electric vehicles and related technologies. The company operates manufacturing facilities in Arizona and Saudi Arabia.

deduped_items.body_text:
Prague Airport Works to Speed Up Border Checks for Non-EU Travellers
Prague Morning
Prague Airport and the Czech Ministry of the Interior are preparing additional measures to reduce waiting times for passengers arriving from non-Schengen countries following the introduction of the EU Entry/Exit System (EES).
The new system has made border checks more complex, particularly for travellers from outside the EU. Prague Airport says it has already introduced several measures aimed at keeping passenger flows moving during busy periods.
Airport staff, known as the Red Team, are assisting passengers in the terminal, directing them through the new procedures and providing information where needed. The airport has also adjusted passenger flow corridors based on data collected since the system was introduced.
One of the main issues identified so far is the self-service registration process. According to the airport, a significant number of passengers do not complete their registration at the kiosks, which can lead to additional delays at passport control.
Prague Airport is therefore examining the entire journey from the registration kiosks to passport control and looking at ways to make the process easier, particularly for families and older passengers.
“Data has shown us that the most common delays occur when people interrupt the registration process at the terminals,” said Radomír Lašák, Chairman of the Board of Prague Airport. “Together with the Police of the Czech Republic, we are not merely putting together temporary stopgaps but are redesigning the entire process so that it remains resilient even during peak periods.”
Further measures are also being prepared at the European level, including the possibility of allowing passengers to complete parts of the EES registration before departure. Airlines could also provide passengers with information about the process during flights.
The Czech Ministry of the Interior and the Immigration Police are working with Prague Airport on the next steps and have committed additional resources to help manage the new system.
Interior Minister Lubomír Metnar said the authorities’ priority was to maintain security standards while limiting the impact of the new procedures on passengers.
The airport said it will continue monitoring passenger flows and adjusting its procedures based on actual operations, particularly during peak travel periods.

deduped_items.title: Video: This week in Finland, 25 September 2026
deduped_items.summary: The week's stories included the army adapting to drone warfare, young women struggling with their mental health, teens guzzling energy drinks, and a rare Moomin mug fetching a record price.
deduped_items.body_text:
Here are some stories making headlines this week:
- Drone warfare is changing army training — Finnish recruits are being spread out in forests rather than grouped together in tents at night, reducing the risk of drones targeting large numbers at once.
- Mental health care gap — Kela figures show that a third of women born in Finland in 1997 had received help for a mental health problem by age 28, compared with around one in seven men born the same year.
- Energy drink concerns — A survey found that a quarter of people in Finland said they started consuming energy drinks before age 12. Finnish teens are also more likely than their Nordic peers to drink coffee.
- Rare Moomin mug sells for 46,000 euros — The 'Diving with Shells' design never went into production, making it an exceptionally sought-after collector's item.

deduped_items.title: Asian Games: Janry Ubas books spot in long jump final
deduped_items.summary: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines—Team Philippines’ Janry Ubas advanced to the men’s long jump final of the Asian Games 2026 after hitting the qualification standard on his second attempt Sunday at Mizuho Park Stadium.
